I am an old man of 76 years, and I have worked this land my whole life here in Amhara. This small plot of 0.20 hectares has my fruit trees and I grow some things between them, as my father did before me. I do not have money for chemical fertilizer on the trees — I put the manure from my animals around them, which is what they need. The trees are old local varieties that my family planted long ago, and we have no irrigation here, only the rains God sends us.

My sons and grandsons help me with this plot because my back is not strong like before. We do not hire workers for such a small piece — the family hands are enough for pruning, weeding, and harvesting the fruit.
